title: small set of drawer organizers
text: small set of drawer organizers. I purchased this smaller set to go along with a larger set of organizers to be sure I had all the sizes I needed.  I probably will have extras but I will use other places.  The only thing I have to note is that the round, raised feet on the bottom of the trays are slippery.  I am considering an additional purchase of rubber feet to press on and help these holders move around less.  I chose the clear and they are - with sort of textured (rolling) bottoms - they are NOT flat.  Also, be sure to measure the depth of your drawers to be sure these organizers will be accommodated. Or.. put a rubbery type drawer liner in the drawer.  Just a thought.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
